secondary_endpoints: logical and elapsed time to resolution
ablation: same captured lifecycle with optional exports withheld; perturbations explicitly labeled

sample_size_status: feasibility pilot design; not powered confirmatory sample; revise with supervisor before freeze

recorded effective policy and restoration evidence
exclusions: Predeclare infrastructure failures; preserve failed runs; do not turn unavailable outcome evidence into a negative label
trust: Do not infer effective operation bounds from unaudited cross-host timestamps
independence: Source evidence adjudicated before detector outputs are inspected
prerequisite: external backing disk or equivalent isolated Windows lab; independent adjudicator
